page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr7.24xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 96 dedicated physical cores with a single thread per core, utilizing the Intel Xeon 8369HB processor running at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz. The instance is equipped with 768.0 GB of system memory, providing a memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per physical core.

This server configuration does not include local storage, requiring network-attached storage solutions for persistent data. It delivers a baseline network bandwidth of 32 Gbps. The absence of integrated GPUs and local NVMe SSDs represents a tradeoff, positioning this instance away from hardware-accelerated graphics or high-speed local caching workloads, and focusing instead on memory-intensive processing.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated physical core allocation combined with a high memory density offers a robust platform for enterprise applications without the overhead of hyperthreading. The resource profile is suitable for memory-intensive workloads, large-scale databases, enterprise resource planning systems, in-memory caching, and high-performance computing tasks that require dedicated CPU execution.
